name: speed-line-action-reveal
intent: Six tapered converging speed lines at frozen 30deg intervals burst outward to reveal TARGET acquisition readout.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Immediately show TARGET; hide speed lines

acceptance: Idle: six tapered lines at frozen 0/30/60/90/120/150deg converging at center
Burst: lines scaleX 0.62→2 and fade over 580ms with 18ms stagger ladder
TARGET reveal scales in after 45% of burst window
Done: lines hidden; TARGET and sub copy visible
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows TARGET immediately
waveC: Tapered line clip-path; frozen angle ladder; polish-only burst timing
